import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path

    assert observed['workers_joined'] and not observed['control_errors']
    for peer in observed['slow_peers']:
        assert peer['peer_terminal_observed'] and not peer['forced_client_close'] and peer['sender_joined'] and peer['sent_progress_bytes']>=4

    assert len(observed['processes'])==1
    assert all(p['output_capture_complete'] and not p['output_capture_errors'] and p['forced_cleanup_not_graceful_evidence'] for p in observed['processes'])
CHECK

python3 - <<'CHECK'
import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path('target/native-http-tls.json').read_bytes())
assert r['passed'] and r['candidate_worktree_clean'] and r['candidate_worktree_clean_at_end']
assert r['candidate_commit']==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
assert r['native_os'] in {'Linux','Darwin','Windows'} and not r['differences']
assert len(r['declared_differences'])==20
assert {d['decision'] for d in r['declared_differences']}=={'https-discovery-on-tls','secure-origin-matches-http-authority'}
for implementation in ['go','rust']:
    assert set(r[implementation])=={'tls12','tls13','mtls12','mtls13'}
    assert sum(len(p['rows']) for p in r[implementation].values())==48
    assert sum(len(p['identity_controls']) for p in r[implementation].values())==12
    assert sum(len(p['encrypted_peers']) for p in r[implementation].values())==8
    for name,observed in r[implementation].items():
        assert len(observed['rows'])==12 and len({x['case'] for x in observed['rows']})==12
        assert len(observed['processes'])==1
        assert all(p['output_capture_complete'] and not p['output_capture_errors'] and p['forced_cleanup_not_graceful_evidence'] for p in observed['processes'])
        assert observed['control_workers_joined'] and not observed['control_errors']
        assert all(p['rejected'] for p in observed['identity_controls'])
        assert len(observed['encrypted_peers'])==2
        for peer in observed['encrypted_peers']:
            assert peer['sender_joined'] and peer['peer_terminal_observed'] and not peer['forced_client_close']
            assert peer['sent_record_bytes']>=4 and peer['sent_record_bytes']<peer['record_length']
            assert peer['server_certificate_sha256']==r['server_certificate_sha256']
            assert peer['tls_version']==('TLSv1.2' if name.endswith('12') else 'TLSv1.3')
            assert peer['termination'] in {'actual-empty-eof-or-reset','complete-go-json-error-before-write-deadline'}
        assert observed['rows'][-1]['case']=='recovery-ping'
        assert observed['rows'][-1]['response']['status_line']=='HTTP/1.1 200 OK'
CHECK
